name: Spare Key
summary: An invite link cut like a brass key, with a live expiry countdown, a use limit and a snapping revoke
about: A workspace invite card with a little key cutting machine. Choose how long the link lasts, how many people can use it and their role, then press Cut invite key: a blank slides into the jaw, the grinding wheel spins up and travels along the blade throwing sparks, and every tooth it cuts types one letter of the link. The finished key pops out with a swinging tag, the expiry counts down in real time, Copy jingles the key and Revoke snaps it in two.
how: Pick an expiry (1 hour, 1 day, 7 days or never), a use limit and Viewer or Editor.
Press Cut invite key and watch the wheel cut the teeth while the link appears letter by letter.
Copy puts the full link on your clipboard; the tag swings and the link lights up.
The line under the link counts down to the expiry and fills a dot for each person who joins.
Change a setting and the key dims until you cut a new one; Revoke snaps it and strikes the link out.
